description: Conan 1.0.1 observability fixes: per-tab cwd footer, Build chip active-window, idle-notification filter (3 surfaces), cwd-based tab names, account-global /usage windows

userStories.title: Track per-tab cwd in the gateway and expose it on /api/terminals
userStories.description: As a multi-tab user, I need the gateway to remember each terminal's current directory (not just the focused one's) so downstream surfaces can show per-tab reality.
acceptanceCriteria: TermSession gains lastKnownCwd: string | null (src/terminal/index.ts)

maybeAdoptCwd (~line 303) stores the parsed OSC 7 cwd into lastKnownCwd BEFORE the focusedTermId gate; background tabs also reset osc7Scan after a successful parse so a lingering report isn't re-applied

pollProcessCwd (~line 345) splits 'track per-tab' from 'move global': it updates lastKnownCwd for any tab (still honoring CWD_POLL_MIN_SPACING_MS per tab) but only calls setActiveCwd for the focused tab
Background tabs never call setActiveCwd directly (US-002 invariant from the app-updates loop preserved)
listTerminalSessions (~line 679) and TerminalSummary include cwd: lastKnownCwd ?? spawn cwd; GET /api/terminals returns it
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Root-cause investigation in HANDOFF.md Issue 1 (line numbers verified 2026-06-10 on main@4448927). Gateway change: requires npm run build:sidecar before any tauri build/test.

userStories.title: Footer cwd + branch follow the active tab instantly
userStories.description: As a user switching tabs, I want the status-bar footer's cwd path and git branch to flip immediately to the tab I'm looking at.
acceptanceCriteria: When focusedTermId changes (WS attach, {type:'input'}, {type:'focus'} handlers ~lines 586-605 of src/terminal/index.ts), the newly focused terminal's lastKnownCwd ?? spawn cwd is pushed through setActiveCwd()
setActiveCwd safeguards stay intact (unchanged path no-ops, invalid path rejected)
Footer git branch recomputes from the same cwd-change notification (verify the git prop source in src/cwd/ listeners; fix if it doesn't follow)
Manual test: two tabs cd'd to different directories; switching tabs flips the footer path and branch with no typing required
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill (Vite dev UI against the gateway; check StatusBar text swaps on tab switch)
userStories.notes: Suggested skills: automate-browser. Depends on US-001. Known watch-item: App.tsx:255 fallback chain (lastCwd ?? activeSession?.cwd ?? config?.cwd) can briefly disagree — eyeball during verify.

userStories.title: Tab names default to the cwd folder basename
userStories.description: As a multi-tab user, I want un-renamed tabs labeled by their working directory folder (e.g. 'conan', 'Design') instead of 'Term N', so I can tell tabs apart at a glance.
acceptanceCriteria: TerminalInfo (ui/src/hooks/useTerminals.ts:5) gains cwd from the US-001 /api/terminals field
terminalLabel (useTerminals.ts:65-71) new fallback chain: /renamed session name:shortId (unchanged, always wins) -> cwd basename -> 'Term N'
Duplicate basenames across tabs are disambiguated (e.g. 'conan', 'conan 2') so the strip never shows two identical labels
Label live-updates when the user cds (next /api/terminals poll picks up the new cwd)
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill (two tabs in different dirs show folder names; /rename still overrides)
userStories.notes: Suggested skills: automate-browser. Depends on US-001. UI-only change.

userStories.title: Build chip stays visible for the duration of a running build loop
userStories.description: As a user running run-tasks.sh, I want the Timeline's Build chip and rows present throughout the run, not just for 60 seconds after each progress.txt write.
acceptanceCriteria: BUILD_ACTIVE_WINDOW_MS (src/timeline/index.ts:11) raised from 60_000 to 1_800_000 (30 min — covers a typical story iteration)
Client mirror in ui/src/components/Timeline.tsx (~line 757, the buildCutoff aging filter) uses the same value — update both constants in lockstep with a cross-reference comment naming the other file
Server gate (src/timeline/index.ts:611-615) verified against a simulated progress.txt write (touch/append the file, confirm Build rows appear via GET /api/claude/timeline and persist past 60s)
Stale-trail suppression still works: a progress.txt last written before the window yields no Build rows
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: HANDOFF.md Issue 2. A pgrep 'runner alive' check was considered and deferred — the wider mtime window is the deliberate v1.0.1 choice (record that in a code comment). The cwd half of the bug is fixed by US-001/US-002 (progress.txt resolves under getActiveCwd, src/tasks/index.ts:8-9). Gateway change: requires npm run build:sidecar.

userStories.title: Filter the idle 'waiting for your input' notification on all surfaces
userStories.description: As a user who steps away after a response, I don't want a 'waiting for input' banner or Timeline row when nothing needs my response — only genuine permission prompts should alert.
acceptanceCriteria: An isIdleNotification(msg) helper matches /waiting for your input/i; permission messages ('Claude needs your permission...') and unknown/missing messages pass through (fail open)
Native banner: ui/src/hooks/useNativeNotifications.ts (~line 118) drops idle notifications before the throttle/send
Timeline backfill: the Notification->NOTIF map in src/timeline/index.ts (lines 221-226) emits no row for idle notifications
Timeline live path: the duplicate map in ui/src/components/Timeline.tsx (lines 221-226) skips them identically
Toaster fallback: check Toaster.tsx for the same Notification relay; if present, filter there too (if absent, note that in progress.txt)
Permission notifications still produce banner + NOTIF row + toast
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill (synthesize an idle Notification event via POST /api/claude/events: no NOTIF row appears; a permission-message event still renders one)
userStories.notes: HANDOFF.md Issue 3. Evidence: event DB groups to 326 idle vs 273 permission messages. Touches gateway (timeline backfill) -> requires npm run build:sidecar. Gateway TS and UI TS don't share a module — keep the regex identical in both with a cross-reference comment.

userStories.title: Promote /usage rate-limit windows to one account-global cache
userStories.description: As a user with several tabs, I need the account-global /usage windows (Current session %, Current week) captured once and served to every session, since they describe the account, not the session.
acceptanceCriteria: Every successful capture path (passive live-pty parse, refresh-injected capture, and the ?probe=1 throwaway probe) writes the windows portion of the frame to a single account-global slot { windows, capturedAt, fromSessionId } in src/usage/probe.ts
The per-session liveCache (~line 522) keeps the SESSION block (cost/wall/per-model tokens) keyed by session id, unchanged
The usage read path serves: the global windows slot (regardless of requesting session) + the requesting session's own SESSION block
Reuse or merge with the existing getCachedPlanUtilization/maybeProbe account-global cache rather than adding a third cache (single source of truth for windows)
API response includes capturedAt (epoch ms) for the windows so the UI can render freshness
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: HANDOFF.md Issue 5 root cause: liveCache holds the WHOLE parsed frame per session, trapping account-global data in whichever session captured it. Gateway change: requires npm run build:sidecar.

userStories.title: Usage panel renders global windows on every tab with a freshness hint
userStories.description: As a user on any tab, I want to see the latest account rate-limit status (e.g. 'Current session 104% used') with how fresh it is, while the SESSION cost block still reflects the active tab.
acceptanceCriteria: The Usage widget (ui/src/components/Widgets.tsx + its hook) renders the US-006 global windows on every tab, independent of which session captured them
A freshness hint renders near the LIVE - FROM /USAGE header (e.g. 'captured 12m ago'); omitted when fresher than ~1 min
'Awaiting capture' appears only when NO capture exists anywhere (then the existing probe/disk-estimate fallbacks apply)
SESSION block continues to show the active tab's own session data and changes on tab switch
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using automate-browser skill (capture /usage in one session; confirm a second session's Usage tab shows the same windows + freshness hint)
userStories.notes: Suggested skills: automate-browser. Depends on US-006. Semantic theme tokens only (text-muted-foreground etc.) per CLAUDE.md conventions. Builds on the app-updates loop's US-005 (persistent skeleton rows) — don't regress it.
